# Meta business AI handles 10 million conversations per week
![Meta's business AI facilitates 10 million conversations per week](https://zamin.uz/uploads/posts/2026-04/zamin_meta-says-its-business-ai-now-facilitates-10-million-convers_20260430_173004_d28edb2d.webp)  

Meta's artificial intelligence tools for business facilitated nearly 10 million conversations per week by the end of March. This figure stood at only 1 million at the beginning of the year. Techcrunch.com [reports](https://zamin.uz/index.php?do=go&url=aHR0cHM6Ly90ZWNoY3J1bmNoLmNvbS8yMDI2LzA0LzMwL21ldGEtc2F5cy1pdHMtYnVzaW5lc3MtYWktbm93LWZhY2lsaXRhdGVzLTEwLW1pbGxpb24tY29udmVyc2F0aW9ucy1hLXdlZWs%3D&lang=en) on this.
Currently, more than 8 million advertisers are using at least one of the company's AI tools. These tools are currently being provided free of charge to small business representatives.
Company CEO Mark Zuckerberg noted that these services could become paid in the future. According to him, while business AI in messaging apps is currently free, work is underway on a long-term monetization model.
Meta continues to integrate AI capabilities into its business products. Specifically, the Muse Spark model, created by the Meta Superintelligence Labs division established last year, has been launched.
According to the results of the first quarter, Meta's net profit amounted to 26.8 billion dollars. Total revenue increased by 33 percent compared to last year, reaching 56.3 billion dollars.
